name: yt-dlp
author: Viboplr
description: Play and download audio and video from YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Vimeo and 1000+ other sites via yt-dlp. Search the web directly with built-in and user-defined web indexers. Replaces the YouTube plugin.

apiUsage.reason: Run yt-dlp (search, resolve, download) and ffmpeg (merge and convert streams)
Search websites directly (the Web tab's built-in and user-added web indexers)
Remember your settings, scoring profiles and web indexer definitions, and manage the audio/video cache
Play any track by finding it on YouTube or SoundCloud when it has no source of its own
Play the exact video or track a ytdlp:// queue entry points at
Download a track by finding it on your configured fallback source

binaryDependencies.name: yt-dlp
binaryDependencies.reason: Search, resolve and download audio/video streams from supported sites

binaryDependencies.name: ffmpeg
binaryDependencies.reason: Merge separate video+audio streams and convert audio to the chosen format
